question: The sum of the radius of the base and height of a solid cylinder is 17 cm. If the total surface area of the solid cylinder is 748 cm², then the height of the cylinder is:
solution:
Given:

The sum of the radius of the base and height of a solid cylinder is 17 cm.

The total surface area of the solid cylinder is 748 cm2.

Concept used:

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

where r = Radius of the base, h = height

π = 22/7

Calculation:

Let the radius of the base and height be R and H respectively.

Total surface area = 2πR(R + H)

According to the question,

⇒ R + H = 17 ....(1)

⇒ 2πR(R + H) = 748

⇒ 2πR × 17 = 748 (From 1)

⇒ πR = 748/34

⇒ 22R/7 = 22

⇒ R = 7

Putting R = 7 in (1),

⇒ 7 + H = 17

⇒ H = 17 - 7

⇒ H = 10

∴ The height of the cylinder is 10 cm.
